svg.title: How a map request moves through GeoLakeLayers
svg.desc: Map clients sign in through the Databricks Apps front door, the gateway builds SQL that runs as the viewer on a SQL warehouse or Lakehouse//RT, Unity Catalog enforces grants, and results return as Esri JSON or GeoJSON. A panel compares the ArcGIS-side Custom Data Feed.
svg.text: How a map request moves through GeoLakeLayers
Unity Catalog tables as live map layers, queried as each signed-in viewer. Nothing is copied to ArcGIS or the client.

Two ways to put Databricks tables on ArcGIS maps
GeoLakeLayers sits on the Databricks side. The Custom Data Feed sits on the ArcGIS side. Pick by the clients you need and whose permissions should apply.
a Databricks App; nothing installed in ArcGIS
